meta.title: Cincinnati
meta.summary: Cincinnati brings river views, hillside neighborhoods, art, markets, and food traditions that are very much their own. We can argue about the chili later.

blocks.text: Hey, those hills and the Ohio River make quite an entrance, don’t they? Downtown, Over-the-Rhine, riverfront spaces, museums, and performances give Cincinnati plenty of ways to fill a day. Cincinnati-style chili and goetta belong to the local food story too. A meal is a rather delicious place to begin exploring.

One map detail before we wander: the wider region reaches across the river, so check which state and neighborhood each stop is in. Visit Cincy collects dining, events, and neighborhood guides. Choose a few nearby places instead of sprinting through everything. A market, a museum, and a long riverside walk already sound pretty good to me.
